notes: Canonical inventory of every current derived dataset/support output. New files under data/derived or domains/*/data/derived must be registered so a plausible map layer cannot bypass source assurance.

datasets.provenance: legacy multi-source energy/REZ synthesis; see energy research registers
datasets.selection_policy: Represent the source-listed NSW declared REZs, Victoria 2025 proposed REZs, and Queensland 2024 potential REZs relevant to the inherited/planned east-coast energy geography while preserving their different dates and status semantics.
datasets.completeness_test: Within the named source families: NSW 5/5; Victoria 6/6; Queensland historical roadmap 12/12. This is not a generator, substation or current Queensland energy-hub inventory.

datasets.selection_policy: Retain high-consequence physical/engineering constraints found in reviewed HSR and conventional-rail studies that materially inform corridor-cost reasoning.
datasets.completeness_test: Every included obstacle must cite a primary study/evaluation. No claim that every obstacle in every study is extracted.

datasets.selection_policy: Track major Australian east-coast HSR study generations and current HSRA work needed to understand evidence lineage, assumptions and policy evolution.
datasets.completeness_test: Every listed study has a source URL; the file is a major-study bibliography, not a claim that every historic paper/proposal mentioning HSR is present.

datasets.selection_policy: Extract decision-relevant quantitative and qualitative findings from reviewed HSR studies, including cost, travel time, engineering and settlement-policy evidence.
datasets.completeness_test: Every evidence row must identify the study and source URL. No claim to reproduce every metric in each study.

datasets.selection_policy: Retain major recent, completed, committed or under-construction east-coast projects that illustrate inherited capital and path dependency at VECA scale.
datasets.completeness_test: Every row must resolve to a primary project/program source and preserve value scope/status. This is not the complete Australian infrastructure pipeline.

datasets.blocker: Independent identity inventory reconciled with zero missing/extra entities; broader attribute/geometry field verification can continue separately.
Independent identity inventory reconciled with zero missing/extra entities; broader attribute/geometry field verification can continue separately.

datasets.provenance: Geoscience Australia Foundation Rail Infrastructure Railway_Lines service
datasets.blocker: Independent identity inventory reconciled with zero missing/extra entities; broader attribute/geometry field verification can continue separately.

datasets.selection_policy: Track strategic intermodal/freight nodes already encountered in VECA corridor research where rail-road-port interfaces materially affect regional optionality.
datasets.completeness_test: Every included node must have a direct authority/operator source. No claim of national terminal completeness until a separate operator/authority census is built.

datasets.selection_policy: Retain transport metrics directly useful to whole-system comparison, including capacity, utilisation, freight/passenger performance and cost evidence where sourced.
datasets.completeness_test: Each metric must preserve source and definition. No claim that all transport KPIs are represented.

datasets.provenance: AEMO 2026 ISP Table 1 east-coast transmission inventory
datasets.blocker: Entity completeness reconciled 21/21; field verification remains sampled, not fully passed.

datasets.selection_policy: Track high-consequence health, education, government-land and related regional anchors in the currently studied VECA regions.
datasets.completeness_test: Every included asset must be directly sourced. This is an anchor set, not a catalogue of all public assets.

datasets.selection_policy: Track major university, TAFE and VET institutions/campuses that materially contribute to skills and knowledge capacity in the studied regional centres.
datasets.completeness_test: Every included asset has a provider/government source URL. Not an exhaustive inventory of every campus, school or training provider.

datasets.provenance: government land plus education optionality synthesis
datasets.selection_policy: Retain government-owned/development land and education assets where land control or institutional capital creates future settlement optionality.
datasets.completeness_test: Included rows require direct provenance and explicit asset class. No claim of complete Crown/government land ownership coverage.

datasets.selection_policy: Track health capital programs and masterplans that expose relocation, renewal or long-horizon expansion choices relevant to VECA.
datasets.completeness_test: Every row resolves to a canonical health plan/project source. Not an exhaustive hospital-capital program census.

datasets.selection_policy: Capture health-capital and service-planning signals that reveal fixed versus flexible future investment across currently studied regions.
datasets.completeness_test: Every included signal must have traceable source provenance. No claim of every health project or budget line.

datasets.selection_policy: Track planning mechanisms, future growth areas, zoning/target frameworks and conservation pre-clearance that materially preserve or constrain settlement options.
datasets.completeness_test: Every row resolves to a statutory/strategic planning source. Not a parcel-level zoning census.

datasets.provenance: regional growth assumptions from government plans
datasets.selection_policy: Capture official growth assumptions for the regional-plan geographies currently selected for VECA comparison, including retained legacy Victorian plans where current statewide planning supersedes but does not erase historical intent.
datasets.completeness_test: Each currently scoped regional baseline row resolves to its plan. Completeness is against the named VECA comparison regions, not every Australian regional plan.

datasets.selection_policy: Track major regional hospital/health anchors whose current or committed capital materially affects settlement inheritance in studied regions.
datasets.completeness_test: Every included asset resolves to one or more primary health sources. Not an exhaustive health-facility inventory.

datasets.provenance: regional planning assumptions extracted from multiple plans
datasets.selection_policy: Extract decision-relevant assumptions from reviewed regional plans, especially population, housing, centre hierarchy, infrastructure sequencing and growth geography.
datasets.completeness_test: Every assumption must cite its source plan. No claim to reproduce every statement in each plan.

datasets.selection_policy: Track new-school, expansion, reservation and growth signals that reveal where governments expect substantial settlement growth.
datasets.completeness_test: Each signal has a government/education source. Explicitly not an inventory of all existing schools.

datasets.selection_policy: Track major industrial/logistics precincts where public enabling infrastructure and private investment jointly create regional economic gravity.
datasets.completeness_test: Every row resolves to all cited program/project sources. No claim of complete industrial-estate coverage.

datasets.selection_policy: Represent major functional water systems encountered in current VECA regions, preserving source, storage, treatment, transfer and augmentation distinctions where known.
datasets.completeness_test: Every system row resolves to utility/authority sources. Geographic gaps remain an explicit research backlog; the set does not claim all east-coast water systems are present.

datasets.blocker: Legacy snapshot retained for history only; canonical domains/government-intent datasets supersede it. Do not use as a new map/data input.
datasets.selection_policy: Retain only as historical project-state evidence while canonical government-intent datasets are migrated.
datasets.completeness_test: No completeness claim. Must not receive new data or be treated as canonical map input.

datasets.blocker: Legacy snapshot retained for history only; canonical domains/government-intent datasets supersede it. Do not use as a new map/data input.
datasets.selection_policy: Retain only as historical project-state evidence while canonical domains/government-intent data supersedes it.
datasets.completeness_test: No completeness claim. Must not receive new data or be treated as canonical map input.

datasets.provenance: multi-DNSP primary-source distribution capacity/augmentation signal synthesis
datasets.selection_policy: Capture high-consequence distribution/sub-transmission capacity, augmentation and enabling-infrastructure signals encountered during the first DNSP ingestion sweep, prioritising regional growth, new economic nodes, data-centre/industrial demand and metropolitan counterfactuals.
datasets.completeness_test: Every included signal must resolve to a primary DNSP DAPR, RIT-D, project or network-planning source and preserve whether the capacity is existing, planned, required or merely proposed. This dataset does not claim to contain every zone substation or network limitation.

datasets.provenance: primary operator campus/portfolio pages and current development announcements
datasets.selection_policy: Capture material east-coast campuses and pipeline assets published by NEXTDC, AirTrunk, CDC and Goodman, plus non-physical portfolio-demand records where needed to preserve contracted-load evidence without double-counting.
datasets.completeness_test: Every row has a primary operator source and explicit capacity definition/status. The set claims broad coverage of the named operators' east-coast campuses encountered in this sweep, not complete coverage of every Australian data-centre owner, planning approval, powered-land proposal or customer load.

datasets.provenance: ARTC Network Investment Program, Route Access source inventory and Inland Rail current progress/route evidence
datasets.selection_policy: Capture current east-coast conventional-rail capability-changing investments, funded corridor programs, Inland Rail section status and the next authoritative operating-capability sources needed to convert rail geometry into a usable capacity layer.
datasets.completeness_test: Every included row resolves to a current primary ARTC/Inland Rail source and distinguishes completed, in-progress, funded-program, approved/preserved and ingestion-target states. The dataset does not claim to contain every ARTC project, train path, loop or route-access parameter.
